title: The One Ring
gametext:
While wearing The One Ring, the Ring-bearer gains hunter 3, and each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
Skirmish: Add a burden to wear The One Ring until the regroup phase.
lore: ...the earth shook, the plain heaved and cracked, and Orodruin reeled.
subtitle: The Ring of Doom

title: The One Ring
gametext:
Response: If the Ring-bearer is about to take a wound in a skirmish, he or she wears The One Ring until the regroup phase.
While the Ring-bearer is wearing The One Ring, each time he or she is about to take a wound in a skirmish, add a burden instead.
lore: One Ring to rule them all....
subtitle: The Ruling Ring

title: Chamber of Records
gametext:
When you play this, you may spot a Dwarf to place 2 [dwarven] tokens here.
Fellowship: Discard this from play or remove a [dwarven] token from here to reveal the top card of your draw deck. If it is a [dwarven] card, take it into your hand, otherwise, place it in your discard pile.

title: The Fortunes of Balin's Folk
gametext: Exert a Dwarf to shuffle a [dwarven] condition with one or more [dwarven] tokens on it into your draw deck. Wound a minion for each [dwarven] token that was on that condition.
lore: 'It is grim reading....'

effect.text: Choose {dwarven} condition to shuffle into deck

title: Gimli
gametext: Damage +1. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)
lore: 'Well, after them!' said Gimli. 'Dwarves too can go swiftly....'
subtitle: Eager Hunter

title: Glóin
gametext:
Each time Glóin wins a skirmish, you may draw 3 cards, then place 3 cards from your hand beneath your draw deck in any order.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to make Glóin strength +2.
subtitle: Son of Gróin

title: Heavy Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf.
This is twilight cost -1 for each [dwarven] card that has a culture token on it.
Skirmish: Remove a [dwarven] token to make bearer strength +1.
lore: Dwarven smiths created weaponry of all sizes and styles.

title: Sturdy Stock
gametext: Make a Dwarf strength +2 (or if you can spot a hunter minion, strength +1 and damage +1 for each hunter minion you can spot).
lore: Dwarves have a knack for surviving misfortune.

title: Well-crafted Armor
gametext:
Bearer must be a Dwarf. Each time bearer takes a wound, you may reinforce a [dwarven] token.
Skirmish: Discard a [dwarven] card from hand to make bearer damage +1.
lore: Dwarven armor is among the strongest crafted in Middle-earth.

title: Whatever End
gametext:
Each time Gimli wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter [gondor] companion or hunter [elven] companion damage +1 until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [dwarven] companion strength +2.
lore: 'I will go with you even on the Paths of the Dead....'

title: Arwen
gametext:
While you can spot Aragorn, Arwen is strength +1 and resistance +2.
Skirmish: Remove an [elven] token to make a minion skirmishing Arwen strength -2.
lore: I do not fear them.
subtitle: She-Elf

title: Dínendal
gametext:
Aid – (3). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (3) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except an [elven] companion, exert bearer.
Bearer is an archer.
lore: Elven archers were seldom seen before it was too late.
subtitle: Mirkwood Archer

title: Elven Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Bearer is an archer.
lore: No finer bows could defend Helm's Deep than those of the Golden Wood.

title: Elven Warrior
gametext:
While this companion is bearing a possession, he is strength +2.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to place an [elven] card from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck.
lore: Elven warriors used their strength and wisdom equally in battle.

title: Focus
gametext:
Each time Legolas wins a skirmish, you may heal a hunter [dwarven] Dwarf or hunter [gondor] Man.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [elven] Elf strength +2.
lore: '...not even my eyes can see him, my good Legolas....'

title: Gift of the Evenstar
gametext:
Each time an Elf wins a skirmish, you may exert that Elf or Aragorn to place an [elven] token here.
At the start of each maneuver phase, you may remove an [elven] token here to draw a card.
subtitle: Blessed Light

title: Haldir
gametext:
To play, spot an Elf.
While the fellowship is at a battleground site, Haldir is strength +2.
While the fellowship is at a forest site, Haldir is an archer.
lore: '...since you come with an Elf of our kindred, we are willing to befriend you, as Elrond asked....'
subtitle: Sentry of the Golden Wood

title: Legolas
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Regroup: Exert 2 hunter companions to draw a card.
lore: 'We have already overtaken some of those that we are hunting....'
subtitle: Fleet-footed Hunter

title: Legolas
gametext:
Archer. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Archery: Exert Legolas to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each hunter minion you can spot (limit +3).
lore: You would die before your stroke fell!
subtitle: Of the Woodland Realm

title: Lórien's Blessing
gametext: Spot an [elven] follower to make the minion archery total -3.
lore: 'We have drunk the cup of parting...and the shadows fall between us.'

title: Mighty Shot
gametext: Spot an Elf to make the fellowship archery total +1 for each minion with a twilight cost of 2 or less that you can spot.
lore: 'But who can say what it hit?'

title: The Mirror of Galadriel
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
Each time you are about to draw a card, you may exert an Elf to look at the top three cards of your draw deck instead. Take a Free Peoples card into your hand and place the other cards on the bottom of your draw deck.

effect.text: Choose Free Peoples card to put into your hand

subtitle: Dangerous Guide

title: Point Blank Range
gametext: Make an Elf strength +2 (or +4 if you can spot 3 archers).
lore: How many there were the company could not count.

title: Spied From Afar
gametext:
To play, spot 3 Elves.
While you can spot an [elven] follower, the twilight cost of each Shadow possession is +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make an [elven] companion strength +1 for each archer companion you can spot.

title: Sword of the Fallen
gametext:
Bearer must be an Elf.
Each minion skirmishing bearer is strength -1 for each wound on that minion.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to exert a minion skirmishing bearer.
lore: Elven weapons remain in use for centuries.

title: Uruviel
gametext:
Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.)
Each time you transfer this to a companion, you may exert an Elf to make the fellowship's current site a forest until the end of the turn.
subtitle: Woodland Maid

title: Be Gone!
gametext: Spell. Exert your [gandalf] companion X times to make a minion strength -2 until the regroup phase, for each time that [gandalf] companion exerted.
lore: You did not kill me, you will not kill him!

cost.text: Choose how many times to exert your companion

title: Ent Avenger
gametext: While you can spot 3 Ents, this companion is strength +2.
lore: As they drew near the flash and flicker of their eyes could be seen.

title: Gandalf
gametext:
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Each time you play a spell, you may add a burden to wound a minion.
At the start of each skirmish involving Gandalf, you may draw a card and then discard a card from your hand.
lore: Let the Ring-bearer decide.
subtitle: Powerful Guide

title: Leaflock
gametext:
Leaflock's twilight cost is -1 for each Ent you can spot.
While you can spot 4 other Ents, Leaflock is strength +4.
lore: When roused to action, little could stop the destructive power of the Ents.
subtitle: Finglas

title: Mellon!
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [gandalf] companions.
At the start of the maneuver phase, discard this condition to make each player count the number of cards in his or her hand, discard each of them and draw the same number of cards from the top of his or her draw deck.

title: Momentous Gathering
gametext: Choose one: spot an Ent to take a [gandalf] companion into hand from your draw deck; or spot 2 Ents to take a [gandalf] companion and a [gandalf] condition into hand from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
lore: '...I have managed to make a fair number promise to come.'

texts: Take a {gandalf} companion and {gandalf} condition into hand

title: One Last Surprise
gametext: Spell. Spot Gandalf and an unbound companion skirmishing a minion to use Gandalf's resistance to resolve that skirmish instead of that companion's strength.
lore: The dragon passed like an express train... and burst over Bywater with a deafening explosion.

title: Quickbeam
gametext:
Quickbeam is twilight cost -1 for each Ent you can spot.
Maneuver: Discard this companion to place another [gandalf] companion from your discard pile on the bottom of your draw deck and reinforce a [gandalf] token.
lore: 'A punch from an Ent-fist crumples up iron....'
subtitle: Hastiest of All Ents

title: Shadow of the Wood
gametext:
This companion is twilight cost -1 for each [gandalf] companion you can spot.
Fellowship: Place this companion in the dead pile to remove (5).
lore: Treebeard's call to the Ent Moot could not be refused.

title: Shepherd of the Trees
gametext:
While you can spot 4 Ents, this companion is strength +3.
Maneuver: Exert this companion to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is a [gandalf] character, you may play it.
lore: Ents rarely interacted with Men, but Saruman's devilry demanded action.

title: Skinbark
gametext:
Skinbark is twilight cost -1 for each [gandalf] condition you can spot.
Each time Skinbark wins a skirmish, you may place a [gandalf] card from your discard pile beneath your draw deck.
lore: '...a man that hacks once at an Ent never gets the chance of a second blow.'
subtitle: Elder Ent

title: Treebeard
gametext:
To play, spot 3 [gandalf] companions.
Each time Treebeard wins a skirmish, the first Shadow player must exert X minions, where X is the difference between Treebeard's strength and the losing character's strength.
lore: My business is with Isengard tonight.
subtitle: Enraged Shepherd

title: Called to Mordor
gametext:
Bearer must be Sméagol.
While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each time an opponent uses a skirmish special ability in a skirmish involving Gollum or Sméagol, you may wound a minion.
lore: It won't be long now. He will soon be ready.

title: Connected By Fate
gametext:
To play, spot Sméagol.
While you can spot 2 Ring-bound Hobbits, each Shadow event is twilight cost +1.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make each Ring-bound companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: Thief, thief! Baggins! We hates it for ever!

title: Controlled By The Ring
gametext:
Bearer must be Gollum.
Skirmish: If Gollum is not assigned to a skirmish, discard this condition to have him replace a minion skirmishing a companion.
lore: Gollum's appetite for the One Ring could not be quenched.

title: Desperate Move
gametext: Discard a [gollum] minion from play to discard a companion. The Free Peoples player may make the move limit -1 this turn to prevent that.
lore: 'He leaped into the waters, but the Ring slipped from his finger as he swam....'

effect.text: Would you like to make move limit -1 this turn to prevent discarding a companion?

title: Gollum
gametext: At the start of each skirmish involving Gollum, he is strength +X until the end of that skirmish, where X is the Ring-bearer's strength.
lore: Give it to us raw and wriggling!
subtitle: Hopeless

title: Herbs and Stewed Rabbit
gametext:
While you can spot Frodo, Sméagol is resistance +1.
While you can spot Sam, Sméagol is strength +1.
While you can spot Bilbo, Sméagol is damage +1.
lore: 'Eat them, Eat them!'

title: Hurry Hobbitses
gametext: Make Sméagol strength +1 for each Ring- bound Hobbit you can spot.
lore: Very lucky we find you.

title: Nice Fish
gametext:
Each time Sméagol wins a skirmish, place a [gollum] token here.
Regroup: Heal a Ring-bound companion for each token here. Discard this condition.
lore: 'Bring fish with you. Come!'

title: Not This Time!
gametext: Skirmish: Exert Gollum and remove a threat to wound a companion Gollum is skirmishing.
lore: Got away, did it, Precious!

title: Release Them
gametext:
Spot Sméagol to prevent a Ring-bound Hobbit from being overwhelmed unless his or her strength is tripled.
While this card is in your discard pile, Sméagol is resistance +1.
lore: If you let them go, your life will be forfeit.

title: Sméagol
gametext:
Ring-bound. To play, add a burden.
Each Ring-bound companion is resistance +1.
Skirmish: Exert 2 Ring-bound Hobbits to make Sméagol strength +1 and prevent him from being overwhelmed unless his strength is tripled.
lore: '...this creature is in some way bound up with my errand.'
subtitle: Wretched and Hungry

title: Something Slimy
gametext: Spot Sméagol to play a condition from your draw deck. If that condition was a [gollum] condition, you may make an opponent place a random card from his or her hand beneath his or her draw deck.
lore: What he was chewing, they did not ask or like to think.

true.text: Would you like to make an opponent place a random card from hand beneath draw deck?

title: Sudden Strike
gametext: Spot Gollum or Sméagol to play a minion from your draw deck. If that minion is a [gollum] minion, you may also play a Shadow possession or Shadow condition from your draw deck. Shuffle your draw deck.
lore: ...she drove her huge bulk down on him again.

title: Swear by the Precious
gametext: Spot Frodo and Sméagol to discard a minion. That minion's owner may make each minion strength -2 until the end of the turn to prevent that.
lore: 'I will serve the master of the Precious.'

effect.text: Would you like to make each minion strength -2 to prevent discarding minion?

title: Unseen Foe
gametext: Discard a [gollum] minion from play to wound each companion with strength 8 or more.
lore: ...all the while he hissed, but spoke no words.

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn to make a hunter companion strength +1.
lore: Ride out with me. Ride out and meet them.
subtitle: Swift Hunter

title: Aragorn
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
Maneuver: Add a threat to exert a non- hunter minion with strength less than Aragorn.
lore: 'I will follow the Orcs....'
subtitle: Thorongil

title: Aragorn's Bow
gametext:
Bearer must be Aragorn.
He is an archer.
Archery: Add a threat to wound a minion with the lowest strength.
lore: The bow can reach what the sword cannot.
subtitle: Ranger's Longbow

title: Damrod
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
At the start of each fellowship phase, you may add (1) to heal a ranger.
lore: 'Curse the Southrons!'
subtitle: Dúnadan of Gondor

title: Decorated Barricade
gametext:
Fortification. This condition is twilight cost -1 for each [gondor] ranger you spot.
Skirmish: Exert 2 [gondor] Men to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.
lore: In times of war, the beauty of the walls matters little.

title: Dúnedain of the South
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Each time this companion wins a skirmish, you may make a [gondor] ranger strength +2 until the regroup phase.
lore: 'We come to ambush the Men of Harad.'

title: Gondorian Prowler
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
When this companion is in your starting fellowship, he is twilight cost -1.
Skirmish: Remove a [gondor] token or exert a [gondor] Man to make the site number of a minion +2.
lore: Rangers use all five senses to hunt their prey.

title: Ithilien Blade
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
While you can spot a roaming minion, bearer is strength +1.
Maneuver: Exert bearer twice to discard a roaming minion.
lore: Most Rangers of Ithilien carried spears, bows, and swords while marching.

title: Mablung
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Skirmish: Exert Mablung to wound a roaming minion he is skirmishing.
lore: 'We come to teach them another lesson.'
subtitle: Ranger of Ithilien

title: Madril
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1.
While you can spot 2 [gondor] rangers, Madril is twilight cost -2.
At the start of the maneuver phase, each minion is site number +1 for each threat you can spot until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: 'For that is the ruin of Osgiliath....'
subtitle: Defender of Osgiliath

title: No Quicker Path
gametext:
Each time Aragorn wins a skirmish, you may make a hunter [dwarven] companion or hunter [elven] companion strength +1 until the regroup phase.
Skirmish: Discard this condition to make a [gondor] Man strength +2.
lore: '...we no longer need any trail to tell us which way....'

title: No Travellers In This Land
gametext: Exert a [gondor] Man to wound a minion (or wound that minion twice if it is a hunter).
lore: '...only the servants of the Dark Tower, or of the White.'

title: Portico
gametext:
Fortification. The twilight cost of this condition is -1 for each [gondor] ranger you spot.
Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 2 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.
lore: The doors of Minas Tirith were meant to keep out more than Orcs.

title: Ranger's Cloak
gametext:
Bearer must be a [gondor] Man.
While bearer is a ranger or at a forest site, each minion skirmishing bearer is site number +2.
Skirmish: Add a threat or exert bearer to make a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man site number +2.

title: Silent Traveler
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
At the start of each skirmish involving this companion and a roaming minion, you may reinforce a [gondor] token.
lore: 'We have not found what we sought....'

title: Tremendous Wall
gametext:
Fortification. Characters skirmishing bearer cannot take wounds from losing a skirmish involving bearer.
Skirmish: Exert a [gondor] Man or spot 3 rangers to transfer this condition from your support area to a minion skirmishing a [gondor] Man.

title: Unyielding Ranger
gametext:
Ranger. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This companion is strength +1 for each roaming minion you can spot.
lore: Their faces were hooded and masked with green, except for their eyes....

title: Bill Ferny
gametext:
If Bill Ferny is unwounded, the Free Peoples player cannot assign him to skirmish a companion.
Shadow: Exert Bill Ferny twice and spot a site you control to add (2).
lore: '...he would sell anything to anybody; or make mischief for amusement.'
subtitle: Agent of Saruman

title: Bold Easterling
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: 'They hold the northward road; and many have passed on into Anórien.'

title: Chieftain of Dunland
gametext:
Fierce.
Skirmish: Spot a site you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +2.
Skirmish: Spot 2 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +3.
Skirmish: Spot 3 sites you control and remove (2) to make a [men] Man strength +4.

title: Courageous Easterling
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: Easterlings came to Mordor to aid Sauron in his final assault.

title: Destroyed Homestead
gametext: When you play this, spot 2 [men] Men to randomly reveal a site from the Free Peoples player's adventure deck. Note its card title. Each site on the adventure path with the same card title as the selected site loses its game text.
lore: Destruction sometimes brings new opportunities.

title: Easterling Scout
gametext: Skirmish: If this minion is skirmishing, discard this minion to play a [men] minion from your discard pile. That minion is fierce until the regroup phase.
lore: In battle, Easterlings surprise their foes with a great number of different techniques.

title: Engrossed Hillman
gametext: At the start of the maneuver phase, if you can spot another [men] Man and 8 characters (or if you can spot 3 Free Peoples cultures), you may take control of a site.
lore: Years of anger have a tendency to bring focus to one's rage.

title: Enraged Herdsman
gametext: While you can spot more companions than minions, each [men] hunter is strength +2 and is an archer.
lore: Dunlendings don't mind being outnumbered in battle.

title: Great Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [men] Man.
While bearer is skirmishing a hunter companion, bearer is strength +2.
lore: To his surprise, Frodo's cloak served as an effective camouflage among the rocks.

title: Grieving the Fallen
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] Man. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer).
Bearer cannot take wounds during the archery phase. At the start of the regroup phase, discard this condition.
lore: Mordor will pay for this!

title: Grousing Hillman
gametext: While you control a site, this minion is strength +3 and fierce.
lore: Acquiring more territories only increases the rage of the Dunlendings.

title: Hunting Herdsman
gametext:
Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
This minion is strength +3 for each follower you can spot.
lore: Hunters are valuable members of Dunlending tribes.

title: Last Gasp
gametext: Wound 3 [men] archers to exhaust a companion.
lore: Southron archers know that they must press through their exhaustion to win the battle.

title: Lying Counsel
gametext: Exert your [men] Man and spot an unbound companion bearing 3 or more cards to return each Free Peoples card that companion bears to its owner's hand. The Free Peoples player may add a burden to discard those cards instead.
lore: 'Let your counsellor Gríma keep all things....'

effect.text: Would you like to add a burden to discard Free Peoples cards from {chosenCompanion} instead of returning them to hand?

title: Mûmak Commander
gametext: Maneuver: Exert Mûmak Commander twice to exert a companion twice (except the Ring-bearer).
lore: ...high upon his neck still desperately clung a tiny figure – the body of a mighty warrior....
subtitle: Giant Among the Swertings

title: Primitive Savage
gametext:
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, if he bears a hand weapon, you may take control of a site.
lore: The only thing scarier than a Wild Man is a Wild Man with an axe.

title: Pursuing Horde
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] Man. Bearer must be a companion (except the Ring-bearer). Limit 1 per companion.
Each time the fellowship moves, add (1).
lore: Once the Dunlendings track their enemy they will not lose their trail.

title: Rapid Reload
gametext:
While you can spot a [men] Man, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site in the current region.
Archery: Spot a [men] Man and remove (3) to exert an unbound companion.
lore: The Men of Harad kept a large supply of arrows at hand.

title: Rapt Hillman
gametext:
At the start of the regroup phase, the Free People's player may liberate a site. You may spot 3 Men to prevent this.
Maneuver: Spot another [men] Man and exert this minion to take control of a site.
lore: Dunlendings take delight in destruction.

effect.text: Would you like to liberate a site?
Would you like to spot 3 Men to prevent liberating site?

title: Ravaging Wild Man
gametext:
While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 [men] Men to discard a follower.
lore: No villager is safe when the Wild Men attack.

title: Savage Southron
gametext: Maneuver: If the Free People's player has at least 1 site in his or her adventure deck, exert 2 [men] Men to randomly choose a site from that deck. Replace the fellowship's current site with that site.
lore: The Southrons are skilled at fighting in many different kinds of terrain.

title: Swarthy Hillman
gametext: While you control a site, this minion is an archer.
lore: The Wild Men will defend their territories at all costs.

title: Wandering Hillman
gametext:
To play, spot a [men] Man.
While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3.
Maneuver: Remove 2 burdens or 2 threats to control a site.
lore: The Hillmen are always searching for lands to conquer.

title: Battlefield Recruit
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +2.
lore: Grond! Grond! Grond!

title: Battlefield Veteran
gametext: Skirmish: Discard this minion to make a minion strength +1.
lore: Though he had seen it many times before, Grond's destructive power never ceased to amaze.

title: Beasts of Burden
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [orc] minions.
At the start of your Shadow phase, you may discard an [orc] condition from play to play an [orc] minion. It is twilight cost -2 (or -4 if you can spot 6 or more companions).
lore: ...some great beast...would go mad and spread stamping ruin....

title: Black Gate Sentry
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
lore: Very few tried to sneak into Mordor. Even fewer succeeded.

title: Black Land Chieftain
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] minion.
When you play Black Land Chieftain, you may add a threat for each Free Peoples possession and each Free Peoples artifact you can spot.
lore: Orcs frequently used the weapons of their fallen enemies as their own.

title: Black Land Commander
gametext:
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +5.
Skirmish: Remove 2 threats to make a character skirmishing this minion strength -2.
lore: '...do they just live on foul air and poison?'

title: Black Land Observer
gametext:
When you play this minion, you may spot an [orc] condition to add a threat.
While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +3.
lore: Orcs must always watch for attacks from their enemies... and from their own.

title: Black Land Overlord
gametext: Maneuver: Remove a threat and spot another [orc] minion to exert an unbound companion.
lore: Move on! To the Gate!

title: Black Land Runner
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] Orc.
While you can spot more sites on the adventure path than minions, this minion is strength +5.
lore: When commanded to, Orcs could travel great distances with great speed.

title: Black Land Shrieker
gametext:
To play, spot an [orc] condition.
Black Land Shrieker is twilight cost -1 for each threat you spot.
lore: No sound from an Orc was more frightening.

title: Black Land Spy
gametext:
When you play this minion, you may spot an [orc] possession to add a threat.
While you can spot a companion of strength 13 or more, this minion is strength +7.
lore: Frodo's quest could be undone with one glance.

title: Coordinated Effort
gametext:
To play, spot 2 [orc] minions.
Each time the Free Peoples player plays a possession, add (2).
lore: Breaking a Gondorian fortification is not easily done.

title: Desolation Orc
gametext: To play, spot 3 Free Peoples cultures or discard 2 [orc] conditions from play.
lore: Neither Man nor beast can withstand the fury of the Orcs.

title: Destructive Orc
gametext: When you play Destructive Orc, you may discard a fortification for each [orc] possession and each [orc] artifact you can spot.
lore: At Minas Tirith, some Orcs chose to attack the city before its inhabitants.

title: Gorbag
gametext:
Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)
When you play Gorbag, you may discard a card from the top of the Free Peoples player's deck for each hunter character you can spot.
lore: I'm gonna bleed you... like a stuck pig!
subtitle: Filthy Rebel

title: Isengard Marauder
gametext:
To play, discard 3 cards from your hand.
While you can spot 2 other [orc] minions, this minion is fierce.
lore: Wargs and riders sent by Saruman disrupted the villagers' retreat to Helm's Deep.

title: Moria Menace
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to make the Free Peoples player shuffle his or her draw deck and reveal the top card of that draw deck. Make this minion strength +X, where X is the twilight cost of the revealed card.
lore: Orcs attacked in sunlight only when absolutely necessary.

title: Mountain-troll
gametext:
When you play this minion, you may discard 5 [orc] minions from play to make it twilight cost -10 and fierce.
Shadow: Remove (3) to play an [orc] Orc from your discard pile. Its twilight cost is -2.
lore: Thrice the great ram boomed. And suddenly on the last stroke the Gate of Gondor broke.

title: Orkish Camp
gametext:
While you can spot an [orc] Orc, the Free Peoples player cannot replace the fellowship's current site.
Shadow: Exert an [orc] minion and remove (2) to reveal the bottom card of your draw deck. If it is an [orc] Orc, take it into hand. Otherwise, discard it.

title: Orkish Hunting Spear
gametext:
Bearer must be an [orc] Orc.
Bearer gains hunter X (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +X.), where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you can spot.
lore: Orcs hunt for Men, ponies, and their own kind.

title: Pummeling Blow
gametext:
To play, exert an [orc] minion. Plays on the fellowship's current site.
This site cannot be replaced. While the fellowship is at this site, each Troll is strength +1.
lore: Where battering rams failed, Trolls did not.

title: Scouting Orc
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
lore: ...it was of a small breed... with wide and snuffling nostrils: evidently a tracker of some kind.

title: Tower Troll
gametext:
For each companion over 5, this minion is damage +1.
Assignment: Exert this minion twice to assign it to a companion (except the Ring-bearer). If you cannot spot 6 companions, the Free Peoples player may exert a companion to prevent this.

true.preventText: Would you like to exert a companion to prevent assigning {chosenCompanion} to skirmish {self}?

title: Unmistakable Omen
gametext:
While you can spot a threat, the site number of each [orc] Orc is -1.
Regroup: Remove 3 threats and discard 3 [orc] Orcs from play to make the Free Peoples player spot a companion and place that companion in the dead pile. Discard this condition.

title: Unreasonable Choice
gametext: Spot 2 [orc] minions to discard a Free Peoples condition. The Free Peoples player may add (2) for each Free Peoples condition you can spot to prevent that.
lore: An attacking swarm of Orcs leaves few desirable options.

effect.text: Would you like to add (2) for each Free Peoples condition to prevent discarding of condition?

title: Veteran War Chief
gametext: Skirmish: Exert this minion to wound a companion it is skirmishing.
lore: '...I'll stick you, if you don't shut it down, see?'

title: Brilliant Light
gametext: Make a [rohan] companion strength +2 (or strength +3 and damage +1 if he or she is a hunter companion).
lore: The Orcs reeled and screamed and cast aside both sword and spear.

title: Burial Mounds
gametext: Make a [rohan] companion defender +1 and minions skirmishing that companion cannot take wounds during a skirmish involving that companion until the regroup phase.
lore: Their hearts were heavy, remembering the many men that had fallen in battle in this place.

title: Éomer
gametext:
Valiant. Hunter 2. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.)
While you can spot a [rohan] Man, Éomer's twilight cost is -1.
Skirmish: Discard a [rohan] card from hand to make Éomer strength +2.
subtitle: Horsemaster

title: Éomer's Spear
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
If bearer is Éomer and he is unwounded, he is damage +1 and resistance +1.
Skirmish: If bearer is Éomer, discard this possession to wound a minion he is skirmishing.
lore: Aim for their heads!
subtitle: Trusty Weapon

title: Éowyn
gametext:
Valiant.
Response: If a hunter companion or valiant Man is about to take a wound, exert Éowyn to prevent that wound.
lore: I can fight!
subtitle: Willing Fighter

title: Gamling
gametext:
Valiant. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.) To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
While you can spot 3 hunters, Gamling is strength +3.
lore: 'Dawn is not far off... But dawn will not help us, I fear.'
subtitle: The Old

title: Grim Trophy
gametext: Make a [rohan] Man strength +1 for each hunter you can spot (or if you can spot more valiant Men than hunters, make a [rohan] Man strength +1 for each valiant Man you can spot).
lore: 'At least they will not love the Orcs.'

title: Haleth
gametext:
While you can spot 2 mounts, Haleth is strength +2.
While you can spot 3 mounts, Haleth is damage +1.
While you can spot 4 Free Peoples mounts, those mounts can not be discarded by a Shadow player.
subtitle: Son of Háma

title: Horse of Great Stature
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
Skirmish: Exert bearer to make a [rohan] Man strength +1.
lore: Aragorn saw a shadow on the distant green, a dark swift-moving blur.

title: Horseman of the North
gametext:
While you can spot a valiant Man, this companion's twilight cost is -1.
This companion is strength +2 while no opponent controls a site.
lore: 'And they became our allies, and have ever proved true to us....'

title: Our Inspiration
gametext: Spot a [rohan] Man to play a possession from your discard pile for each hunter character you can spot.
lore: Decorative armor adorned the hallways and armories of Helm's Deep.

title: Last Days of My House
gametext: Spot 2 [rohan] Men (or 1 hunter [rohan] Man) to play a [rohan] companion or a [rohan] follower from your draw deck.
lore: No parent should have to bury their child.

title: Rider's Mount
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
At the start of each skirmish involving bearer, each minion skirmishing bearer must exert.
lore: Their horses were of great stature, strong and clean- limbed; their grey coats glistened, their long tails flowed in the wind....

title: Rohan Stable Master
gametext:
Aid – (1). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (1) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
Bearer is considered to be mounted.
lore: Rohirrim warriors were seldom seen without their mount.

title: Rohan Worker
gametext:
Aid – (1).
Each time you transfer this to a companion, except a [rohan] companion, exert bearer twice.
Each time bearer wins a skirmish, you may liberate a site.
lore: In preparation for the Battle of Helm's Deep, everyone helped fortify the doors and walls.

title: Rohirrim Axe
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
While bearer is skirmishing a hunter minion, bearer is damage +1.
lore: Rohirrim young and old were given weapons of all kinds to defend Helm's Deep.

title: Rohirrim Doorwarden
gametext:
Aid – (2). (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add (2) to transfer this to a companion.) To play, spot a [rohan] Man.
Bearer is strength +1 for each possession he or she bears.
lore: '...any weapon that you bear, be it only a staff, you must leave it on the threshold.'

title: Rohirrim Soldier
gametext:
Valiant. While you can spot a [rohan] Man, this companion's twilight cost is -1.
This companion is strength +1 for each hunter minion you can spot.
lore: 'Let us ride on!'

title: Rohirrim Warrior
gametext:
Valiant.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot a hunter minion (or exert 2 valiant Men) to make this companion defender +1 until the regroup phase.
lore: '...a warrior should have more skills and knowledge than only the craft of weapons and slaying....'

title: Spear of the Mark
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
If bearer is mounted, bearer is defender +1.
lore: Rohirrim spears are much deadlier when the bearer is on horseback.

title: Sturdy Shield
gametext:
Bearer must be a [rohan] Man.
While no opponent controls a site, bearer is strength +1.
Regroup: Discard this to liberate a site (or two sites if bearer is mounted).
lore: Sometimes the best offense is a good defense.

title: Swift Stroke
gametext: Spot your [rohan] Man bearing a possession to discard all possessions from one character.
lore: ...she drove her sword between crown and mantle, as the great shoulders bowed before her.

title: Community Living
gametext: Spot a Hobbit to play a [shire] follower from your draw deck.
lore: ...ease and peace had left this people still curiously tough.

title: Frodo
gametext:
Ring-bearer. Ring-bound.
While skirmishing a minion of strength 8 or less, Frodo is strength +2.
lore: 'Let's... get out of this cursed place as quick as we can – if we can!'
subtitle: Weary From the Journey

title: Hobbit Sword
gametext: Bearer must be a Hobbit.
lore: These are for you. Keep them close.

title: Hobbiton Brewer
gametext:
Aid – Add 2 burdens. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add 2 burdens to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot a Hobbit.
Response: If bearer is about to take a wound, transfer Hobbiton Brewer to your support area to prevent that wound.
subtitle: Maker of Fine Ales

title: Hobbiton Farmer
gametext:
Aid – Add a burden. (At the start of the maneuver phase, you may add a burden to transfer this to a companion.)
To play, spot 2 Hobbits.
Bearer is strength +1 for each fierce minion you can spot.
lore: ...for ages folk in the Shire smoked various herbs....
subtitle: Lover of Pipeweed

title: Little Golden Flower
gametext:
Each Hobbit bearing a hand weapon is vitality +1.
Each Hobbit bearing a follower is resistance +1.
Each unwounded Hobbit is strength +1.
lore: '...she is very beautiful, and is going to be beautifuller still.'

title: Merry
gametext:
While Merry bears a follower, he is strength +2.
Skirmish: If Merry is skirmishing a hunter minion, add a threat to make Merry strength +2.
lore: Three-foot-eight? You did something!
subtitle: The Tall One

title: No Visitors
gametext: Transfer a follower from a Hobbit to your support area to cancel a skirmish involving that Hobbit.
lore: No thank you!

title: Pippin
gametext:
Each [shire] follower is twilight cost -1.
Skirmish: If Pippin is skirmishing a hunter minion, exert the Ring-bearer to make Pippin strength +2.
lore: I've always been taller than you.
subtitle: The Short One

title: Relaxation
gametext: Response: If a Shadow card is about to add any number of burdens, discard a [shire] follower and this condition from play to prevent that and discard that Shadow card.
lore: As for the Hobbits of the Shire... they were a merry folk.

title: Sam
gametext:
Ring-bound. While Sam bears the One Ring, he is resistance -4.
Maneuver: If Sam is bearing a follower, exert him to heal another Hobbit.
Response: If Frodo is killed, make Sam the Ring-bearer.
subtitle: Innocent Traveler

title: Second Breakfast
gametext: Add a threat and exert your Ring-bearer to wound each non-hunter minion skirmishing your [shire] Ring-bearer.
lore: Don't think he knows about second breakfast, Pip.

title: Advancing Horde
gametext:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each site you control.
lore: To war!

title: Charging Uruk
gametext:
Fierce.
During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +3 and gains hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
lore: They kept no order... yet their speed was very great.

title: Chasing Uruk
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may spot 4 hunters (or Uglúk) to control a site.
lore: 'But why not kill them quick, kill them now?'

title: Covetous Uruk
gametext:
Damage +1.
This minion is strength +1 for each possession you can spot.
lore: The Uruk-hai pillage the remains of the fallen merely to satisfy their bloodlust.

title: Defensive Rush
gametext:
While you can spot an [uruk-hai] minion, the Free Peoples player cannot replace a site.
At the start of each skirmish, you may remove (3) to heal an [uruk-hai] minion (or heal an [uruk-hai] minion twice if you control a site).
lore: Though the arrows rained down, the Uruk formation did not break.

title: Following Uruk
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, you may exert a companion not assigned to a skirmish.
lore: The hobbits were left with the Isengarders: a grim dark band... of large, swart, slant-eyed Orcs with great bows and short broad-bladed swords.

title: Hunting Uruk
gametext: While this minion is at a battleground site, it gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).
lore: They're taking the Hobbits to Isengard!

title: Lurtz
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time Lurtz wins a skirmish, the Free People's player must exert X companions, where X is the current region number.
lore: You will taste man-flesh!
subtitle: Now Perfected

title: Lurtz's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.
Bearer gains hunter 1 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.).
If bearer is Lurtz, he is fierce.
lore: Defeating an Uruk with a broad-bladed sword is not easily done.
subtitle: Mighty Longsword

title: Mauhúr
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Assignment: Exert Mauhúr to assign him to a non-hunter character (except the Ring-bearer).
subtitle: Relentless Hunter

title: Merciless Berserker
gametext:
Damage +1.
Shadow: Exert this minion to exert X companions and add X threats, where X is the number of Free Peoples cultures you spot over 2.
lore: These are Uruk-hai. Their armor is thick and their shields broad.

title: Poised for Assault
gametext:
Each time a companion loses a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, place an [uruk-hai] token here.
Skirmish: Remove 2 [uruk-hai] tokens from here to take control of a site.
lore: Over the wall... the last assault came sweeping like a dark wave upon a hill of sand.

title: Pursuing Uruk
gametext:
Fierce.
During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it gains hunter 4.
lore: 'I wish to kill, and then go back north.'

title: Searching Uruk
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
Searching Uruk is strength +1 for each other [uruk-hai] hunter you can spot.
lore: '...we must stick together....'

title: Seeking Uruk
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non- hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
During a fierce skirmish involving this minion, it is strength +1 for each hunter you can spot.
lore: 'Rest while you can! We'll find a use for your legs before long.'

title: Sentry Uruk
gametext:
To play, spot an [uruk-hai] minion.
While you can spot a fierce minion, this minion is fierce.
While you can spot a hunter, this minion gains hunter 1.
While you can spot a character that is damage +1, this minion is damage +1.

title: Tracking Uruk
gametext: Hunter 1. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +1.)
lore: 'We are servants of Saruman the Wise, the White Hand: the Hand that gives us man's-flesh to eat.'

title: Uglúk
gametext:
Fierce. Hunter 3. (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +3.)
At the start of each skirmish involving Uglúk, each non-hunter skirmishing Uglúk must exert.
lore: '...let's have no more nonsense!'
subtitle: Ugly Fellow

title: Uglúk's Sword
gametext:
Bearer must be an [uruk-hai] Uruk-hai.
While you control 2 or more sites, bearer can not take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
If bearer is Uglúk, he is damage +1.
lore: 'I don't trust you little swine.'
subtitle: Weapon of Command

title: Uruk Cavern Striker
gametext:
Damage +1.
Skirmish: Spot a Free Peoples player's site on the adventure path and exert this minion twice to exchange the spotted site with a site you control. You now control the spotted site.
lore: Get them into the caves.

title: Uruk Infantry
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot a companion of strength 10 or more, this minion is strength +2.
Regroup: Exert 4 [uruk-hai] minions (or discard 3 [uruk-hai] minions) to take control of a site.
lore: March to Helm's Deep! Leave none alive!

title: Uruk Village Assassin
gametext:
Damage +1.
At the start of the maneuver phase, you may spot another [uruk-hai] minion and remove 3 [uruk-hai] tokens to take control of a site or discard a follower.
lore: Rohan, my Lord, is ready to fall.

title: Uruk Village Rager
gametext:
Damage +1.
Each time this minion wins a skirmish, take control of a site.
While you control a site, this minion cannot take wounds (except during the skirmish phase).
lore: They come to destroy its people.

title: Uruk Village Stormer
gametext:
Damage +1.
While you can spot a companion of strength 12 or more, this minion is strength +4.
Each time a companion or ally is killed during a skirmish involving an [uruk-hai] minion, you may take control of a site.
lore: Saruman's hordes will pillage and burn....

title: Violent Hurl
gametext: Make an [uruk-hai] minion strength +2 (and damage +1 if that minion is a hunter).
lore: Uruk-hai weaponry was built to be used offensively and defensively, depending on the situation.

title: With All Possible Speed
gametext:
Each unwounded hunter [uruk-hai] minion is strength +1.
Response: If your hunter minion is about to take a wound during a skirmish, discard that minion to exert a non-hunter companion.
lore: 'They seemed to have left winter clinging to the hills behind.'

title: Later Than You Think
gametext: Remove 2 threats to play a Nazgûl. That Nazgûl is twilight cost -2 and gains hunter 2 (While skirmishing a non-hunter character, this character is strength +2.) until the start of the regroup phase.
lore: The Nine have left Minas Morgul.

title: A Shadow Fell Over Them
gametext:
Each time a Nazgûl wins a skirmish, you may exert 2 Nazgûl (or a Nazgûl twice) to add a threat.
Assignment: Spot a Nazgûl and remove (4) to play a Nazgûl from your discard pile.
lore: ...a blind fear and a deadly cold fell on them. Cowering they looked up.

title: They Feel The Precious
gametext: Response: If a Nazgûl is about to take a wound, remove a threat to prevent that wound.
lore: 'Three times is a threat. They feel us here....'

title: Úlairë Attëa
gametext:
Fierce.
Úlairë Attëa is strength +1 for every 3 twilight tokens you can spot.
lore: The Nazgûl were strongest, and most terrifying, at night.
subtitle: Desirous of Power

title: Úlairë Lemenya
gametext:
Fierce.
When you play Úlairë Lemenya, you may remove (1) to add a threat for each Free Peoples culture you can spot.
lore: Soon there could be no doubt: three or four tall black figures were standing on the slope, looking down on them.
subtitle: Eternally Threatening

title: Úlairë Nelya
gametext:
Fierce.
While you can spot 6 companions, [wraith] minions cannot take wounds (except during skirmish phases).
Skirmish: If this minion is mounted, exert him twice to wound a companion bearing a [wraith] condition.
subtitle: Fell Rider

title: Anduin River
gametext: River. The fellowship archery total is -3.

title: Breeding pit of Isengard
gametext: Underground. The twilight cost of the first hunter minion played each Shadow phase is -2.

title: City Gates
gametext: When the Fellowship moves to this site, add a threat (or 2 if you can spot a hunter minion) for each companion over 4.

title: East Wall of Rohan
gametext: At the start of the fellowship phase, you may exert two hunter companions to play a hunter companion from your draw deck.

title: Gate of Mordor
gametext: Battleground. Each time the fellowship moves to this site, add (1) for each culture you can spot.

title: Isengard Ruined
gametext: Battleground. Each time a follower is transferred to a character, the first Shadow player may exert a companion twice.

title: Mount Doom
gametext: Battleground. Mountain. Underground. Until the end of the game, sites in this region cannot be replaced.

title: Westfold Village
gametext: Plains. Each hunter character is strength +1.

title: Forth the Three Hunters!
gametext:
Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters).
Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).
subtitle: Dwarven Version

title: Forth the Three Hunters!
gametext:
Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters).
Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).
subtitle: Elven Version

title: Forth the Three Hunters!
gametext:
Archery: Exert Legolas and exert Aragorn to wound a minion.
Skirmish: Exert Aragorn and spot Gimli to make a minion strength -1 (or -3 if Aragorn and Gimli are hunters).
Regroup: Exert Gimli and spot Legolas to draw a card (or 2 cards if Gimli and Legolas are hunters).
subtitle: Gondor Version
